The Ooni of Ife, Oba Adeyeye Enitan Ogunwusi, Ojaja II, on Friday attended the convocation ceremony of his former wife, Prophetess Naomi Silekunola, at Elizade University in Ondo State. A gospel musician, Dare Justified, disclosed this in a post on his Instagram page on Friday. He said the ceremony was held in Akure, adding that the monarch was present to celebrate the milestone alongside family and friends. Justified described the convocation as another beautiful milestone for the former queen Silekunola, and prayed that it would open doors to greater opportunities for her. Silekunola had said ahead of the ceremony that she sat the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board examination again after more than a decade to secure admission to the university in Ilara-Mokin, and that she combined motherhood with full-time studies for four years. The university said it combined the 10th and 11th convocations and billed it to cover 964 graduands, 116 of them with First Class honours. The Ooni and Silekunola married in October 2018, but she announced their separation on December 23, 2021.
